The conditions and events of a period relevant to interpreting a work.
An interpretation attending to colonial power, resistance, and continuing effects of colonialism.
An interpretation examining gender, power, and representations of women and other gendered experiences.
Relationships through which a text echoes, transforms, or responds to other texts.
The way a text depicts people, identities, experiences, or ideas.
The portrayal of a group as fundamentally alien or inferior to a dominant group.
A willingness to examine one's assumptions and learn respectfully from differing lived experiences.
Studying texts together to identify meaningful similarities, differences, and contexts.
